thread:
nina_support: FYI - customer reported spike of 503s from hosted inference API around 15:04 UTC. sample req id: req_0a1b2c. They see ~18-22% failures, timeouts on retries. Can SRE triage?

maria_support: Thanks. I opened a ticket and escalated to oncall. Customer impact: several customers on the same dedicated pool are affected, some retries causing tails.

logan_oncall: I'm looking. Alerts show repeated container restarts on upstream inference workers in pool eu-west-1a. PIDs dying and kube restarting pods.

james_sre: grabbing logs from the runner nodes. command: `kubectl -n infer logs -l app=infer-runner -c runtime --since=10m`

james_sre: snippets show repeated failures: ```
[2026-03-17T15:03:58Z] runtime: segfault (SIGSEGV) at 0x7fffa12b
[2026-03-17T15:04:01Z] infer-runner[12345]: CUDA out of memory trying to allocate 1.2GiB
[2026-03-17T15:04:01Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 12345 (infer-runner) score 987 or sacrifice child
```

logan_oncall: stack traces point to libtorch/pytorch kernels for attention-slice. Also saw `invalid device pointer` in a few logs. This looks like GPU OOM followed by segfault during cleanup.

raj_engineer: Was there a recent model swap or quantization change? I just checked deploys - no model changes in last 2 hours. There was a config change to kv-prefetch yesterday.

maria_support: Customer said they ramped QPS by ~3x with a single large request window right before the spike.

james_sre: Repro plan: 1) hit same model in eu-west with a small stress test (batching + long context) 2) tail pod logs and monitor GPU mem 3) try reduced batch size to see if OOM disappears.

logan_oncall: As immediate mitigation, I'm enabling fallback routing for the affected customer to smaller-vocab variant and reducing max_batch_size for that tenant pool to 1. Applying policy now.

deploy-bot: rolled out route override for tenant acme -> model: redwood/small-v1 (canary) at 15:08 UTC.

nina_support: Let customer know we routed them to a safer model and are triaging; they asked for ETA.

raj_engineer: Quick config to toggle prefetch: `env KV_PREFETCH=false` on infer-runner. Suggest disabling prefetch on one node to test.

james_sre: I disabled kv-prefetch on two pods in the pool and restarted them. Observed memory usage drop and no immediate segfaults on those pods. Other pods still showing restarts.

logan_oncall: For now we have 3 mitigations in flight: 1) fallback routing 2) reduce max_batch_size to 1 for pool 6 3) disable kv-prefetch on a subset of pods. Monitoring error rate.

alerts-bot: [Alert] upstream-runner-restart spike in eu-west-1a: 120 restarts / 10m -> reduced to 7 restarts after mitigations.

maria_support: Customer updated: errors dropped but they still see some 503s (low %) during heavy tails. Asking for root cause and permanent fix.

raj_engineer: From core dumps we've got a recurring pattern: `libtorch: aten:: ... kernel_launch -> invalid address` on certain attention kernel config when sequence_len > 2048 and with async prefetch. Might be a bug in the attention CUDA kernel under high mem pressure + prefetch active.

james_sre: Next steps: 1) reproduce locally with same model and long context (seq 4096) 2) create a minimal repro harness to confirm kernel crash 3) try a runtime build with boundary checks on attention kernel 4) backport hotfix or disable problematic optimization.

logan_oncall: ETA for hotfix depending on repro. If we can't reproduce in 2-3 hours, we'll keep mitigations and schedule a patch. Notifying product about potential rollback of kv-prefetch optimization.

maria_support: I'll update customer: temporary mitigations applied (fallback routing + batch size reduction + partial prefetch disable). We'll follow up with RCA and timeline for patch.

nina_support: Customer requested whether billing will be impacted by fallback routing. Answer: standard routing applies; support to coordinate credits if SLA missed.

raj_engineer: Quick workaround to prevent OOM spikes until fix: enforce per-request token cap and per-model reserved memory quota on pods. I'll open a PR for safety limits.

james_sre: Logging full GPU memory metrics and adding additional guardrails (OOM alerts, earlier fallback). Also uploading coredumps to S3 for deeper analysis.

logan_oncall: I'm keeping this thread open. If error rate increases again I'll promote to Sev-1. For now status: degraded -> partial mitigation.

maria_support: Noted. I'll send a formal update to the customer and schedule a post-mortem once fix is ready. :thumbsup:

nina_support: thanks team. we'll keep monitoring.
